تستوعبوا (form X)
# تَسْتَوْعِبُوا (tastawʕibū) /tas.taw.ʕi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْعَبَ (istawʕaba)
# تُسْتَوْعَبُوا (tustawʕabū) /tus.taw.ʕa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْعَبَ (istawʕaba)
